propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner.run() currently iterates only static req.criteria and does not include dynamically activated project criteria, causing project findings to lack logical criterion_id attribution and to never execute in Round A/B
Project criteria must execute exactly once in Round A only, never in Round B, and must carry both physical reviewer_id provenance and logical criterion_id in findings
Missing or malformed project criterion prompts must raise a located LLMError naming the criterion and expected .rebar/prompts path, not fail silently or degrade to built-ins

The solution requires assembling active LLM-tier project entries at gate_dispatch.py using registry.effective_criteria() and registry.effective_routing(), then passing them to CodeReviewBatchRunner as additive project_criteria
round_b requests must not execute project entries even if configured; the Round A/B branch is stateless and replay-deterministic, using no mutable seen-set
